local_qualification.local_resource_limit: Full desktop Clippy exhausted Windows memory; local core/CLI checks and exact-source hosted CI were used.
local_qualification.full_final_source_qualification: Hosted Windows CI and exact packaged CLI regression, with source and SHA256 provenance.

core_cli.note: The full local desktop Clippy attempt exhausted Windows memory. All local core/CLI tests and Clippy passed. The QA parser-error assertion was then corrected and the 80-case CLI gate rerun successfully; application sources are unchanged. Full desktop/workspace qualification is provided by exact-source hosted CI.

limits: Measurement vertices and calibration are entered as displayed-page coordinates in Rich annotations. Maximum 128 vertices and 0–4 decimal places; simple polygons only. Feet/inches are decimal units.

Each annotation has its own calibration. Recreate it to change geometry or scale; generic move/resize/label edits are refused to prevent stale takeoffs. No page-wide recalibration, vector snapping, viewport scales, volume, symbol recognition or automatic counting is claimed.

Measurement JSON records use a documented SuniPDF format; third-party proprietary measurement compatibility and universal imported-metadata support are not claimed. The AEC backlog acceptance criteria remain open where incomplete.

Image stamps are limited to 64 MiB encoded, 4096 pixels per side and four million pixels. Embedded pixels are independent of the source image after Apply. No digital-signature or identity verification is implied.
Local tools remain free and open source. Projects edits remain deferred.

Windows packages remain unsigned without an independent publication key; ARM64 is cross-built only. Native hardware, printing, Narrator, installed updater interaction, broader hostile/customer corpus and PDF/A/PDF/UA conformance remain separate 1.0 qualification.
delivery: PR #14 squash-merged after exact-head Windows and CodeQL checks. Immutable main/tag source and downloaded packages qualified. Post-publication commit contains documentation only; code and PR checks remain enabled.
